orig.il: with thee, and that ye may increase
And thou shalt teach them diligently
and they shall be as frontlets
And it shall be, when the Lord
not; when thou shalt have eaten
with thee, and that thou mayest go in

orig.gloss: and/ you will take possession of

orig.il: from thence, that he might bring us in
that he might preserve us alive
And it shall be our righteousness
